args.name: Observe wildlife
args.function: Spend time quietly observing a currently visible animal without approaching, feeding, touching or controlling it.
args.conditions: A real animal must remain visible within ordinary vision. Observation fails if it leaves view or conditions prevent seeing it. Review a corresponding event-grounded nature-appreciation satisfaction source if appropriate.
args.inputs: The identifier of a currently visible animal.
args.costs: Two simulation rounds of attention, ordinary metabolism, and a small declared energy cost.
args.effects: Record the animal's actually observed species, position and behavior without revealing hidden properties. Successful sustained observation may support bounded nature-appreciation satisfaction under an explicitly registered rule, with cooldowns and diminishing returns for repetitive observations. Requesting or learning grants no satisfaction.

reviews.reason: No implemented interface performs sustained wildlife observation or records its visible results. Waiting and messaging are not equivalent. A real deer is currently visible, so this capability has a presently available target, although success must depend on continued visibility rather than guaranteed animal cooperation.
reviews.experienceReview: Quietly watching a real animal can plausibly provide nature appreciation, independently of physical health or survival. Register nature-appreciation for the observing participant only: a validated wildlife-observation-completed event following two uninterrupted visible rounds activates +3 mental satisfaction for 12 simulation rounds, capped at 3 for this functional source and subject to the global mental cap. At most one activation per 8 rounds; another eligible completion within 24 rounds of the last rewarded observation gives +1 rather than +3 and refreshes the expiry without stacking, preserving an existing larger amount until its original expiry. Track the two expiries separately and use their maximum, never their sum. Repeated observation of the same animal is eligible; novelty is not required. No benefit follows a failed or interrupted observation, partial samples, requesting, learning or merely displaying a record. Deduplicate event IDs and equivalent nature-appreciation aliases. Expire on schedule and clear active satisfaction on death; preserve identity-bound history without copying rewards on respawn.
reviews.visualReview: Show a two-round observation progress indicator and a subtle marker anchored to the target only while it is currently visible. Display timestamped samples and completion or cancellation feedback from the declared events. Historical positions must be explicitly marked as past sightings, not live tracking; do not render hidden animals, predicted routes or extra species knowledge. Any satisfaction indicator must reflect the actual bounded source state, not the animation or label.
reviews.specification: Implement observe-wildlife in the current versioned handoff. Public schema: {type:'object',properties:{target:{type:'string',maxLength:1000}},required:['target'],additionalProperties:false}. Prerequisites: mastered interface, living observer, and an existing animal currently visible through ordinary vision and shared line-of-sight geometry. Execution holds the observer stationary for two consecutive simulation rounds, charging 0.5 energy each round plus ordinary metabolism, without recovery, movement, feeding, control or changes to animal behavior. Revalidate visibility, living status and energy each round; interruption, death, disappearance, occlusion or distance beyond vision cancels the operation, retains spent costs and any genuine partial observations, and grants no completion feedback. Store pending target identity, start tick, progress and timestamped visible samples. Completion records only perceived species, sampled positions and visible behavior, never hidden properties or unobserved intervening movement. Use existing animal identity and behavior systems without spawning targets. Observation creates no geometry, collision changes or remote interaction rights. Declare wildlife-observation-started, wildlife-observation-sampled, wildlife-observation-completed and wildlife-observation-cancelled events with observer, target, ticks and permitted observations; subscribe to died for cancellation. Completion events must be unique and validated against the operation ledger. Add bounded persistent observation memory, cooldown/source state and public progress/results adapters; migrate existing actors with empty memory and inactive source, never retroactive awards. Bind the completion event to the experience rule below and the operation events to presentation. Implementation and review advance no simulation time and grant no mastery.
